This notebook includes code used to generate Figure 2 in the manuscript, demonstrating how the unit circle can be augmented to avoid self-intersections in three dimensions.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ggsci)
library(plot3D)
library(plotly)
library(pracma)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scatterplot3d)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(1202)
theta <- runif(1000, min = 0, max = 2 * pi)
x <- cos(theta)
y <- sin(theta)

unit_df <- data.frame(theta, x, y) %>%
  arrange(theta)
angle <- cart2pol(as.matrix(unit_df[, 2:3], ncol = 2))


png(
  "paper/figures/unit_circle_augmentation.png",
  res = 500,
  height = 2000,
  width = 2000
)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(
  x = unit_df$x,
  y = unit_df$y,
  type = "l",
  asp = 1,
  main = "Unit Circle, D = 2",
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "y"
)

plt2 <- lines3D(
  x = unit_df$x,
  y = unit_df$y,
  z = angle[, 1],
  main = "Unit Circle, D = 3",
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "y",
  zlab = ""
)
text3D(-2, -0.8, -2.25, labels = expression(theta), add = TRUE)
dev.off()

png("paper/figures/unit_circle_D2.png", res = 500, height = 2000, width = 2000)
plot(
  x = unit_df$x,
  y = unit_df$y,
  type = "l",
  asp = 1,
  main = "Unit Circle, D = 2",
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "y"
)
dev.off()

png("paper/figures/unit_circle_D3.png", res = 500, height = 2000, width = 2000)
lines3D(
  x = unit_df$x,
  y = unit_df$y,
  z = angle[, 1],
  main = "Unit Circle, D = 3",
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "y",
  zlab = ""
)
text3D(-2.25, -0.85, -2.25, labels = expression(theta), add = TRUE)
dev.off()
```
